properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key used for signing JWT tokens.

properties.name: jwt.expiration-ms
properties.description: JWT token expiration duration in milliseconds.

properties.name: app.admin.email
properties.description: Default admin account email, created at startup.

properties.name: app.admin.password
properties.description: Default admin account password (BCrypt-hashed at startup).

properties.name: stripe.secret.key
properties.description: Stripe secret key (sk_test_... or sk_live_...). Leave empty to disable card payments.

properties.name: stripe.webhook.secret
properties.description: Stripe webhook endpoint secret for validating incoming Stripe events.

properties.name: app.frontend.url
properties.description: Base URL of the frontend application, used for Stripe redirect URLs.

properties.name: app.upload.dir
properties.description: Directory path for storing uploaded product images.
